call_points.text: Management aims for annual PAT positivity for the peptide CDMO business in FY27 despite quarterly variations.
Europe delivered strong growth of 81% year-on-year, representing approximately 15% of total revenue.
Q4 FY26 gross margin expanded to 65.7%, up 233 bps YoY and 186 bps QoQ.

guidance.statement: We expect revenue growth to continue in FY27
We expect EBITDA margins to stay in the 22% to 23% range

operating_notes.text: Gagillapur facility faced a USFDA warning letter in February 2025 leading to voluntary operational pauses and higher consultancy and freight costs.
Complex Gx share in FD reached 43% in FY26.
Peptide CDMO business added INR1,593 million in FY26 revenue and turned EBITDA positive in Q4.
USFDA issued EIR with VAI classification for Chantilly, Virginia plant following March 30–April 3, 2026 inspection (4 observations closed).
Peptide CDMO Q1 revenue was CHF5 million, broadly in line with expectations
Genome Valley facility utilization expected to cross 50% by year-end
GPI facility utilization at ~70% with room for expansion
Funds from February 2026 preferential issue deployed faster than envisaged; promoter sold 1.72 Cr shares to fund second tranche.
Promoters paid balance 75% subscription of ₹1,093 Cr for 2,49,14,530 warrants, making company net cash surplus on a consolidated basis.
Following allotment of 2,49,82,906 shares to promoters on warrant conversion, 17,094 non-promoter warrants remain outstanding.
Submitted Paragraph IV certification for Ruxolitinib Extended-Release Tablets ANDA claiming potential sole first-to-file status.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,470.61 Cr (+22.8% YoY), net profit ₹201.57 Cr (+32.6% YoY).
Granules India reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹5,366 Cr (+20% YoY) and PAT of ₹595 Cr (+19% YoY).
Granules India reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,471 Cr and net profit of ₹202 Cr.
Granules India Limited uploaded the Q4 and FY2026 earnings conference call recording on April 29, 2026, via its investor resources page.
Granules India reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,471 Cr and net profit of ₹202 Cr, with FY26 revenue reaching ₹5,366 Cr.
USFDA issued an EIR with VAI status to subsidiary Granules Pharmaceuticals, Inc. for its Chantilly, Virginia plant.
Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,476.77 Cr (+22.0% YoY), net profit ₹179.96 Cr (+59.8% YoY).
Q1FY27 results: revenue ₹1,477 Cr (+22% YoY), PAT ₹180 Cr (+60% YoY), EBITDA ₹339 Cr (+37% YoY).
Promoter Dr. Krishna Prasad Chigurupati sold 1.72 Cr shares (reducing promoter stake to 31.08%) to fund preferential issue tranche 2.
Promoters paid ₹1,093 Cr balance subscription for 2.49 Cr warrants, moving Granules India into a net cash surplus position.
Allotted 2,49,82,906 equity shares to promoters on conversion of warrants at ₹585 per share, raising ₹1,461.50 Cr total consideration.
Granules India outlined a ₹2,000 Cr capex plan over 3-4 years to scale complex generics, oncology, peptide CDMO and US operations, targeting USD 50M peptide CDMO revenue run rate in three years.
Granules submitted Paragraph IV certification for Ruxolitinib ER Tablets ANDA, claiming potential sole first-to-file status with 180-day exclusivity.
